scope: Mathematical and defensive evaluation of binary/Koblitz point decomposition and index calculus; no deployed target or private-key recovery
claim_boundary: Until all seven campaign gates pass, results are internal engineering or toy-research measurements and are not a Koblitz index-calculus SOTA claim

required: The predicate is a function only of public field and curve parameters
No enumeration of the target prime-order subgroup is used to choose the predicate
No discrete-log labels of factor-base points are constructed or consumed
Discovery, predicate construction, materialisation, rationality and subgroup-membership filtering are timed and charged when present
stage_1_predicates: GGMP linearised-polynomial kernel derived from an irreducible factor of T^n-1
factor_base_admissibility.excluded: The scalar-selected explicit Frobenius-orbit base used in continuation-02 through continuation-04

stage_1_pdp_matrix.purpose: Freeze one-source, matched point-decomposition instances and measure every locally available solver without conflating a PDP with a complete DLP
stage_1_pdp_matrix.seed_rule: cell i uses seed 20260909+i in listed order

representations.standard: Symmetrised S4 source ANF, exported to native in-tree XOR, WDSat ANF, CryptoMiniSat CNF-XOR and Magma BooleanPolynomialRing from the same rows
representations.ggmp: Chained S3 source ANF over the algebraically derived invariant basis, exported to the same backends from the same rows

stage_1_pdp_matrix.instance_class: Planted SAT point-decomposition targets generated from three factor-base points. This tests witness-finding cost; a later matched random-target panel is required for refutation cost.
stage_1_pdp_matrix.missing_backend_rule: Record unavailable_operational and continue other cells. Missing licensed or installed software is not negative evidence about the algorithm.
stage_1_pdp_matrix.unknown_rule: A resource-capped Unknown or timeout is inconclusive and is never UNSAT.
stage_1_pdp_matrix.model_gate: Every SAT model must satisfy the frozen source ANF. A model-validation failure invalidates the cell.

required_stages: relation collection including every failed or unknown solver call
accounting.instrument: Each command runs under a fresh Python meter process using getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN), so user time, system time and maximum RSS are scoped to that command. Internal nanosecond stage timers and solver counters are retained in the instance manifest.

later_stages.stage_2: Complete unknown-scalar relation-collection and linear-algebra runs with an admissible algebraic factor base whose point logs are not known by construction.
later_stages.stage_3: Measure the same curve and targets with a verified signed-Frobenius/negation quotient Pollard-rho implementation; charge setup, cores, memory and wall time.
later_stages.stage_4: Repeat the frozen panel across seeds and hosts, obtain an external reproduction, then conduct independent source-pinned novelty review.

success_criteria: All stage-1 requested cells are generated from admissible predicates and have source hashes
Every available backend has a truthful terminal or inconclusive record with the required resource fields
n=31 and n=41 are executed, plus at least one larger literature PDP rung
The later-stage unknown-scalar, Pollard-rho, external-reproduction and novelty gates are completed before any SOTA claim
invalidation_rules: Selecting a factor base from scalar labels or a subgroup log table
Comparing solver outputs generated from different source polynomial rows as if matched
Dropping discovery, setup, failed calls, linear algebra or parallel speculative work from a full-cost total
Treating Unknown, timeout, missing Magma or missing CryptoMiniSat as UNSAT or algorithmic evidence
Calling a PDP-only result an end-to-end ECDLP result
Calling an internal agent review an external reproduction

primary_sources.title: A SAT-Based Approach for Index Calculus on Binary Elliptic Curves
primary_sources.provenance: retrieved and locally source-pinned in the Crypto Autoresearcher corpus
